name: Cart
description: Shopping cart: the basket, the buy box, buying from catalogue cards and the choice window.

options.dialog: Show a window: what was added, the basket total, "Checkout"
options.toast: Show a notice in the corner
options.nothing: Nothing — the basket icon in the header counts it

settings.label: After a product is added to the basket
settings.help: On the product page, on catalogue cards and in the choice window. The search window has its own setting.

settings.label: Quick view on catalogue cards
settings.help: An eye in the card's corner opens the product in a window — its pictures, its main characteristics, the choice and "Add to cart" — without leaving the list.

settings.label: "Add to cart" on catalogue cards
settings.help: A product that must be chosen first (options, variations) gets a button with a gear, which opens the choice in a window.

settings.label: Choose the quantity on a card
settings.help: A − 1 + stepper opens beside the button when the pointer is over it. On a touch screen the button adds one.

settings.label: Keep untouched carts for, days
settings.help: A cart nobody has come back to is deleted after this. Long enough to email about it and to answer "what did they nearly buy"; 0 keeps them for ever.
